_readme: FIRST-DRAFT config for TaS2005, built to support grid_preperation marker
detection with the new TaS2005 corner marker (see grid_preperation/config/TaS2005.json).
ONLY substrate_hsv_range is measured from real data (sampled directly from
1st-99th percentile S/V -- same method flake_detection's own derive scripts use).
Every other field below (flake hsv_range/rgb_range, area/solidity/score
thresholds) is COPIED AS-IS from TS34001.json as a structural placeholder --
NOT derived from any real TaS2005 flake sample. Do not trust this for actual
flake detection/scoring until re-derived from real flake images on this chip.
marker_removal_enabled is false: no separate pink-dot location marker was
observed in the sample image -- the winged-cross itself IS the location
marker here (handled by grid_preperation.markers, not this module's own

_comment: MEASURED from real TaS2005/Post Exfo/QK.png (mode-centered hue band,
1st-99th percentile S/V, ~840000 substrate px sampled from a clean
mid-image region). The purple/violet substrate here sits at a
noticeably different, wider hue band than TS34001's (210-290) -- do
not reuse another dataset's substrate range for TaS2005.
